location.site_context: DCA DRI initial form places Project Rita at 2008 Highway 74 West. Local reporting describes the site west of GA Highway 74 between Kirkley Road and the Fulton County/Fairburn boundary, with the Fayette County portion intended for annexation into Tyrone.

status_as_of_cutoff: local process / approved zoning only. Town of Tyrone's data-center page says the Microsoft data center project was approved by Town Council in March 2024 and zoning approval remains in place, but its current-status language says that as of May 2026 no site plan, land-disturbance permit, or building-permit applications had been submitted; the same page's construction FAQ states no site plan, land-disturbance permit, building permit, or other development permit application had been submitted as of 06/02/2026. Georgia DCA lists DRI #4094 Project Rita as Completed, which confirms regional-review process status, not construction or permit issuance. Microsoft confirmed in May 2026 that it is planning a Tyrone datacenter and held a May 19, 2026 community information session. No construction, energization, or certificate-of-occupancy evidence was found in this refresh.
evidence_grade: A- for entitlement/status, based on official Town of Tyrone, Georgia DCA DRI, and Microsoft Local sources. Capacity remains B-/unverified because official DRI energy-load fields do not publish MW, while DCD and Cleanview report 96 MW from secondary/project-tracker sources.

actions.government_body: Georgia Department of Community Affairs / Town of Tyrone
actions.result_status: DCA DRI #4094 initial form was submitted for Project Rita by Tyrone. The form identifies the location as 2008 Highway 74 West, the developer/applicant as Fayette County Development Authority, and describes a technology-based light industrial park incorporating 504,600 square feet in two buildings while also listing project size as 1,500,000 square feet.
actions.access_caveat: Official DCA DRI form; DRI filing data is not a building permit or construction authorization.
actions.evidence_note: Official DRI application evidence for address, applicant, project description, jurisdiction note, and projected seven-year overall completion.

actions.government_body: Georgia Department of Community Affairs / Town of Tyrone
actions.result_status: DCA DRI #4094 additional form was submitted. It lists estimated value at build-out of $350 million, estimated annual local tax revenue of $4 million, Fayette County Water System as water provider, .225 MGD water demand, Fulton County Water & Sewer through Tyrone as wastewater provider, 0.075 MGD sewage flow, 500 peak-hour vehicle trips, and 25% projected impervious surface. The peak connected electrical load field did not publish a MW value.
actions.access_caveat: Official DCA DRI form; utility/provider estimates are planning-review inputs and do not prove permit issuance or construction.
actions.evidence_note: Official DRI evidence for water, wastewater, economic, traffic, stormwater, and missing MW details.

actions.result_status: Town page lists a Planning Commission public hearing for the Microsoft project. It does not publish a vote tally in the accessible summary.
actions.access_caveat: Town page links minutes/video, but the accessible summary does not reproduce the full packet or tally.

actions.result_status: Town page lists the Town Council public hearing preceding the later approval. No vote tally was published in the accessible summary.
actions.access_caveat: Linked minutes/video were not independently extracted in this pass.

actions.result_status: Official town page states the rezoning request associated with the Microsoft data center was approved after advertised Planning Commission and Town Council hearings. The accessible page does not publish the vote tally or ordinance number.
actions.access_caveat: Town summary is the accessible official record; no vote is reconstructed beyond the town's statement.
actions.evidence_note: Land-use approval; not a site plan, building permit, or construction start.

actions.result_status: DCA application summary lists Project Rita as DRI #4094, developer Fayette County Development Authority, current status Completed, DRI tier Metro, GRTA jurisdiction Yes, DRI determination date 05/09/2024, and determination text Warrants regional review.
actions.access_caveat: DCA status refers to DRI process completion, not local site-plan approval, land-disturbance permit, building permit, construction start, or energization.

actions.access_caveat: Company/community update; confirms Microsoft planning role but does not establish permit issuance, construction start, or energization.
actions.evidence_note: Primary company confirmation of Microsoft involvement.

actions.result_status: Town page states that no site plan had been submitted and no land-disturbance, building, or other development permit applications had been submitted as of June 2, 2026; zoning approval remains in place.
actions.access_caveat: Official status page; it does not establish the absence of confidential utility discussions.
actions.evidence_note: Negative permit status, not a revocation or construction decision.

capacity_note: Official DCA DRI additional form leaves peak connected electrical load unpublished. DCD reported 96 MW on 2024-03-20 and again cited a 500,000-square-foot campus on 2026-05-05; Cleanview lists 96 MW and planned/2030, but these are secondary/project-tracker figures and conflict with the DRI form's square-footage fields. Keep capacity_mw null until an official utility, permit, DRI, or Microsoft source publishes MW.
